name: Lu Chu-ch’i
bio: Lu Chu-ch’i is dated by Giles to the 18th century AD. His poem here is an impromptu couplet.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: An Impromptu
poems.author: Lu Chu-ch’i
poems.text:
Though the torrent be swift, it can ne'er carry off the moonbeam that lights up its bed;
Though the mountain be high, yet it cannot arrest the fast-flying cloud overhead.
